Fit a scaled non-central chi^2_1 distribution using BOBYQA

fit_scaled_noncentral_chi2.Rd

Numerically maximizes the likelihood of a scaled non-central chi-square distribution (df=1) truncated above a specific threshold. The fit is conditional on the threshold.

Usage

fit_scaled_noncentral_chi2(wald_stats, wald_thresh)

Arguments

wald_stats

Vector of Wald statistics (non-negative).

wald_thresh

Threshold below which data is included in the fit.

Value

Vector of c(scale, shift).

Examples

fit_scaled_noncentral_chi2(5 * stats::rchisq(1000, 1, ncp=10), 20)
#> scaling   shift 
#>      NA      NA
